facts.business: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited is an Indian listed company that underwent a merger with Oliver Engineering Private Limited and Adicca Energy Solutions Private Limited effective April 1, 2025, as approved by NCLT Mumbai Bench.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure on Property, Plant and Equipment including Capital Work in Progress

auditor.name: M/s. P G BHAGWAT LLP, Chartered Accountants (jointly with M/s. Kirtane & Pandit LLP, Chartered Accountants)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 52 regarding merger of Oliver Engineering Private Limited and Adicca Energy Solutions Private Limited with the Company approved by NCLT Mumbai Bench dated June 02, 2026 with effect from April 01, 2025, and consequential effect on Current Tax and Deferred Tax.

key_risks: Contingent liabilities from direct and indirect tax litigations pending with various tax authorities
Significant capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment with judgement involved in capitalisation criteria per Ind AS 16
Judgement in determining eligibility of costs including borrowing costs for capitalisation
